title: veil policy
description: Which detectors veil runs and what it does with each finding. A detector missing from `detectors` does not run.

version.description: Policy contract version. Identifies the contract, as HCS-0000 does with hcsVersion.

cif.description: Spanish CIF company tax ID (category CIF).

card.description: Payment card number, Luhn-checked with a known issuer prefix (category TARJETA).

name-catalog.description: Names from the client catalog (category NOMBRE). Runs only when a catalog is configured.

secret-path.description: Tool call targeting a secrets-bearing file. No safe rewrite exists.

binary-content.description: Tool output veil cannot scan (binary or base64). No safe rewrite exists.

ner.description: Person names found by a local NER model in a sidecar (category NOMBRE). Any sidecar failure fails the event closed.

store.description: Pseudonym store retention (GDPR art. 5(1)(e)). Without this member veil never deletes a session on its own.

ttl.description: How long a session may sit unused before veil deletes it: an ISO 8601 duration (RFC 3339 Appendix A) in days, hours and minutes, for example P30D or PT12H. Must be positive.

catalog.description: Name catalog for the name-catalog detector. A relative path is resolved against the policy file's directory.

action.description: rewrite: replace each match with a stable pseudonym token. deny: block the event.

model.description: Model catalog id. Without it, VEIL_NER_MODEL selects the model; setting both is invalid.

timeoutMs.description: Deadline for one sidecar exchange, in milliseconds. Default 2000.
